description: Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-21 mounted on a landscaped traffic island at a major junction in the Ramouseh industrial district of southern Aleppo, an area heavily fought over between 2012 and 2016. Recorded by spottingmode in December 2018 with no airframe linked. Confirmed as a mounted aircraft on a kerbed island on Esri imagery of 23 April 2024. No serial is published.
